solutions_not_found: That article does not exist, or it belongs to another team.
solutions_list_totals_note: These numbers cover every article, not just the ones shown.
solutions_filter_meta: Published means customers can read it. Approving it is a separate step
solutions_empty_filtered_body: Nothing in the knowledge base matches those filters. Clearing them shows everything.
solutions_empty_body_tickets: Write the answer once, link it from the tickets that ask for it, and stop retyping it. The first one usually comes straight out of a ticket you just resolved.
solutions_empty_body: Write the answer once and stop retyping it. A published article is what customers read in the portal, and in the public help center once it is switched on.
solutions_gate_approved_tickets: Approved, but not suggested on tickets yet.
solutions_gate_admin_publish: An admin has to publish it.
solutions_gate_reviewed_admin: Someone has read this. Approving it is what lets it be published.
solutions_gate_reviewed_waiting: Waiting on an admin to approve it. Until then it stays internal.
solutions_gate_draft: This is a draft. Send it for review when the answer is right: somebody other than you has to approve it before it can be published.
solutions_detail_not_linked: not linked to a ticket yet
solutions_detail_delete_explain: Deletes {title} permanently. This cannot be undone.
solutions_detail_nobody_attached: Nobody has attached this to a ticket. Either the question has stopped being asked, or the article is hard to find while somebody is typing a reply.

match.countPlural=one: {countShown} other ticket uses this article and is not yours to open.
match.countPlural=other: {countShown} other tickets use this article and are not yours to open.

solutions_detail_how_used_body: Published articles are offered on the ticket screen while somebody is typing a reply. An article nobody has linked to a ticket is usually one that answers a question nobody asked.
solutions_form_consequence_live: Live for customers to read, and suggested on tickets.
solutions_form_consequence_refused: This will be refused: an article has to be approved before it can be published. Set the status to Approved, or leave it internal for now.
solutions_form_consequence_approved: Checked, but no customer can read it yet. Publishing is what releases it.
solutions_form_consequence_internal: Internal only. Agents can still search for it and attach it to a ticket.
solutions_new_sub: Write the answer once, attach it to every ticket that asks
solutions_new_title_placeholder: Fixing an SSO login loop after an identity provider change
solutions_form_title_hint: Say the symptom the way a customer would report it, not the fix.
solutions_new_answer_placeholder: What is happening, why, and the steps that resolve it.
solutions_new_answer_short: A few more words: this is the text an agent will paste to a customer.
solutions_new_answer_hint: This is pasted into replies as-is, so write it to be read by the person with the problem.
solutions_new_tags_lead: Internal filing. Customers never see these names, but articles sharing one are shown to each other in the portal.
solutions_new_review_lead: These are two separate facts about the article and this form keeps them separate.
solutions_form_approve_admin: Approving is an admin's call. It is what lets an article be published.
solutions_edit_notice_tickets: This article is published, so anything saved here is what customers read in the portal and what agents are offered on tickets.
solutions_edit_notice: This article is published, so anything saved here is what customers read in the portal.
solutions_edit_answer_hint: This is pasted into replies as-is.
solutions_edit_tags_lead: Customers never see these names, but articles sharing one are shown to each other in the portal.
solutions_edit_locked: A published article cannot move back down the workflow. Unpublish it first.
solutions_edit_approve_hint: Approving does not publish it. That is a separate button on the article.
